prompts.travel.route.detailed: Draft a route: [city], [days] days, interests: [interests], pace: [relaxed or packed], getting around by [how]. By day: morning, afternoon, evening, 2–3 places, rough travel time between them. Mark what needs booking ahead. Don't invent places you're not sure exist.
prompts.travel.route.refine: Day [number] is too packed. Remove one place and suggest an optional extra if I have energy.
prompts.travel.route.check: Here's my final route: [route]. Where are the transfers too long?
prompts.travel.areas.short: Group these places by area: [list of places]
prompts.travel.areas.detailed: I have a list of places in [city]: [list of places]. Group them by area so I'm not going back and forth. Table: area, places, time needed, what's nearby to eat or rest (in general terms). If you're not sure which area a place is in, mark it “check”.
prompts.travel.areas.refine: In what order should I visit the areas if I start from [starting point]?
prompts.travel.areas.check: Which places on the list can I safely skip if I'm short on time?
prompts.travel.questions.short: What should I find out before a trip to [destination]?
prompts.travel.questions.detailed: I'm going to [destination] for [days] days, [with whom]. List the questions to sort out in advance: documents and entry, phone and internet, payment and money, transport, local rules and customs, weather, insurance, what to do in an emergency. For each, where to check (type of official source).
prompts.travel.questions.refine: I'm travelling with a child aged [age]. Which questions should I add?
prompts.travel.questions.check: Here's what I've already found answers to: [answers]. What's left?
prompts.travel.rain.short: What can I do in [city] on a rainy day?
prompts.travel.rain.detailed: If it rains in [city], suggest a day plan for [who's travelling]: 4–5 indoor activities of different kinds (museum, market, workshop, café, cinema), how to combine them, how long each takes. No specific names unless you're sure the place exists and is open — otherwise describe the type of place and how to find one.
prompts.travel.rain.refine: Make a cheaper or free version.
prompts.travel.rain.check: Which of these still work if the rain stops by lunchtime?
prompts.travel.season.short: What should I pack for [destination] in [month]?
prompts.travel.season.detailed: I'm going to [destination] in [month] and plan to [activities]. Describe the usual weather at that time (noting it's only a guide), then list clothes and gear: layers, footwear, protection from sun, rain or cold. Mark what can be bought there.
prompts.travel.season.refine: Cut it down to one suitcase for [how many] people.
prompts.travel.season.check: My list: [list]. What's missing in case the weather changes suddenly?
prompts.travel.culture.short: What should I know about the culture and customs of [destination]?
prompts.travel.culture.detailed: I'm going to [destination]. Tell me briefly and without stereotypes: customary greetings, behaviour in public and religious places, dress, tipping, photographing people, local holidays in [month], 10 useful phrases in the local language with pronunciation. Mark what's worth checking with locals.
prompts.travel.culture.refine: Suggest 3 books, films or music to understand the culture better. Only ones you're sure exist.
prompts.travel.culture.check: Here's how I plan to [action]. Could it come across as disrespectful?
prompts.travel.time.short: I have [hours] hours in [city]. What can I fit in?
prompts.travel.time.detailed: I have [hours] hours in [city] between [what's before] and [what's after]. I start from [starting point, no exact address]. Interests: [interests]. Suggest 2 routes: relaxed and packed. For each, places in order, time at each, and a buffer for getting back. Mark a point where I can stop if I run out of time.
prompts.travel.time.refine: Make it a walking-only route, no transport.
prompts.travel.time.check: If I leave [minutes] minutes later, what should I cut?
prompts.travel.transport.short: Compare ways to get from [origin] to [destination].
prompts.travel.transport.detailed: I need to get from [origin] to [destination], [when], [how many] people, with [what kind of] luggage. Compare options in a table: mode, approximate travel time, relative cost (cheaper, mid, pricier), comfort, flexibility, what to check. Don't give exact prices or timetables unless you're sure.
prompts.travel.transport.refine: What should I choose if the main priority is [priority]?
prompts.travel.transport.check: What backup options should I have if [option] is cancelled?
prompts.travel.official.short: What should I check on official websites before travelling to [destination]?
prompts.travel.official.detailed: I'm a citizen of [country] travelling to [destination] for [days] days for [purpose]. List what needs checking with official sources: entry and visa, passport validity, rules for minors (if travelling with children), customs, insurance, rules for carrying medicines, travel advisories. For each, which type of official website to look on. No document numbers needed.
prompts.travel.official.refine: Write search queries to quickly find these official pages.
prompts.travel.official.check: Here's what I found on the official site: [text]. Explain in simple words what it means for me.
prompts.travel.budget.short: Help me build a trip budget: [destination], [days] days.
prompts.travel.budget.detailed: Make a trip budget template as a table: [destination], [days] days, [how many] people. Rows: travel, accommodation, food, local transport, entry tickets, phone and data, insurance, souvenirs, contingency (10–15%). Columns: estimate, actual, difference. Leave the amounts blank — I'll fill them in with checked prices.
prompts.travel.budget.refine: I'm over budget by [amount]. Where can I save without spoiling the trip?
prompts.travel.budget.check: Here's my filled-in budget: [budget]. Which line have I probably underestimated?

verify.travel.route: Check opening hours, prices and distances on official sites and maps before you go: the AI's may be outdated or invented.
verify.travel.areas: Check every place on a map: the AI may get the area wrong or name somewhere that's closed.
verify.travel.questions: Look for answers on visas, entry rules and insurance only on official websites.
verify.travel.rain: Check the places are open on your day: museums and galleries are often closed on Mondays.
verify.travel.season: Check the forecast 2–3 days before you leave: seasonal averages don't guarantee the weather on your dates.
verify.travel.culture: Customs vary within a single country. Check official tourism sites or ask local people.
verify.travel.time: Allow extra time for transport and queues: AI plans tend to be too optimistic.
verify.travel.transport: Check timetables and fares on the carriers' official websites: they change often.
verify.travel.official: The AI only suggests what to check. Read the actual rules on government, embassy and carrier websites.
verify.travel.budget: The figures in the budget are yours. The AI doesn't know current prices, so plug in amounts you've checked.
